note: On-demand CSS animation library. Every demo is a page /play/<category>/<animation>/<direction> (basic/scale-up/scale-up-center, text/blur-in/blur-in-expand …), but the category pages are client-rendered: the sitemap lists only /play and the six categories and every category page serves the same SPA shell, so urls_from + render caches the links of the six category pages (filters/rendered-urls-{1..6}.json). One item per animation direction; the animation overview pages /play/<category>/<animation> are listings of their own directions, so they are not matched.
